qsm-setup install.description: Install every discovered plugin, a named list, or a profile, in dependency order, collect-all

args.name: dryRun
args.description: report what each installer would do

args.name: force
args.description: let each installer replace a bin link that is not its own

qsm-setup activate.description: Run one plugin's activation, the only step that changes files you own (the Claude home, settings); its choices follow a -- separator

args.name: dryRun
args.description: report what the activation would change

qsm-setup doctor.description: Probe each installed plugin, name orphans, check built binaries against the record, and check the Claude Code installation

args.name: verbose
args.description: print probe output for passing plugins too

qsm-setup relink.description: Regenerate fish completions and prune undeclared binaries and completions

args.name: auto
args.description: relink only when setup.json opts this machine in

qsm-setup build-bins.description: Run every plugin's own build step and record the binaries it produced

qsm-setup tools.description: Compare the installed qsm binaries and their verbs against origin/main as last fetched

args.name: fetch
args.description: git fetch origin main first; the only network call
